# Alem

> Infrastructure for agentic commerce, starting with finance. Alem is building the control layer for business payments. Finance supports invoices, approvals and reconciliation today.

## Products and status
- Live: Alem Finance — https://finance.askalem.com/ — invoice review, approval workflows, imported payment matching and open balances. Workspace: https://app.finance.askalem.com/.
- Private beta: Alem ROI & Agent Gateway — https://beta.askalem.com/ — agent identity, budgets, policy checks, human approvals and outcome tracking in a sandbox.
- Next, via partners: live payment execution on bank, card and stablecoin rails. No live settlement is currently connected.

## Why invoices
Invoices establish the obligation, approvals establish authority and reconciliation records the outcome. This is the starting point for controlled agent payments.
The homepage policy illustration is local demo logic with synthetic requests. It does not execute payments or create a production audit record.
